demographic_extractions.definition: one model output for one document, carried forward

documents_readable.definition: retrieved documents with a text layer on at least one page

documents_retrieved.definition: documents whose bytes are held under a recorded sha256

documents_tried.definition: distinct (submission, source URL) addresses requested or recovered

duplicated_numbers.definition: submission numbers that appear on more than one source row

evidence_records.definition: one piece of evidence joining a submission or family to a registered study

families.definition: submissions grouped as one product line: candidate (same organisation and whole core name) or curated (devices/families.csv). Not a count of products unless curated

organizations.definition: one canonical manufacturer key: spellings joined by the normalisation rules or the alias file

pairs.definition: one distinct (submission or family, registered study) joined by at least one evidence record

source_rows.definition: one line of FDA's AI/ML-enabled device list as downloaded; what the AI Devices tab counts today

studies.definition: distinct NCT ids that are the target of at least one evidence record

submissions.definition: one distinct FDA submission number; rows sharing a number are one submission

substantive_documents_readable.definition: readable documents of a type that describes a study population (510(k) summary, decision summary, summary of safety and effectiveness) and belong to the submission itself

metrics.definition: source rows beyond the first for a submission number (rows minus distinct submissions)
duplicated numbers whose rows are byte-identical in every column
duplicated numbers whose rows differ only in a company or device spelling that normalises to the same key
duplicated numbers whose rows disagree on anything else
families listed in devices/families.csv; all others are candidates grouped by rule
families holding more than one submission
submissions that share their family with at least one other submission; a name match cannot tell them apart
organisations listed under more than one raw spelling
organisations formed by a curated alias (the only way differently named organisations merge)
submissions for which openFDA returned exactly one record with the number
submissions whose official record disagrees with the list on decision date, product code, applicant or device name
submissions with at least one retrieved document of their own
submissions holding a readable document of a type that describes a study population
addresses that returned a PDF now held by hash
addresses the host answered 404 for
addresses that failed for any other reason (see table documents_by_availability)
retrieved documents with no text layer on any page (scans; no OCR is run)
retrieved documents with at least one page whose text layer is unreadable (fonts without a character map); those pages are treated as having no text
retrieved documents with at least one page that has no usable text layer
retrieved documents the extractor could not read or has not read
readable documents whose text contains at least one NCT id
substantive readable documents with study language (keyword rule) and no NCT id: a negative finding
substantive readable documents whose only study language says no clinical study was done
evidence records whose source is one submission
evidence records whose source is a family (or a parent submission): not specific to one submission
records where an identifier in a retrieved source resolves to the other entity (automated check)
records whose cited NCT id the registry does not hold: unresolved
search hits kept for visibility that fail an explicit rule
heuristic or otherwise unconfirmed records
family-level candidates: device name in a title or intervention and the sponsor agrees
family-level candidates: device name in a title or intervention, sponsor does not agree
name-only matches rejected by rule: the name floods the registry and no organisation agrees
records a person has decided (accepted, rejected or unresolved) in devices/reviews.csv
distinct (submission, study) pairs with at least one identifier-confirmed record
distinct (family, study) pairs resting on name evidence only, not rejected by rule
distinct pairs whose every evidence record was rejected by rule
distinct pairs resting only on a citation in the ORIGINAL PMA of a listed supplement
submissions with at least one identifier-confirmed record, by any route
submissions whose own document cites an NCT id that resolves
submissions whose exact number stands in a retrieved field of a registry record
distinct studies joined to a submission by an identifier-confirmed record
families with at least one name-and-organisation candidate
families whose only candidates are name-only (not rejected by rule)
submissions whose family has a name-and-organisation candidate; the candidate is not specific to any one of them
carried-forward extractions that report at least one demographic value
carried-forward model outputs with demographic sections missing (parsing failure)
